cards.src_text: Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy against the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) shall not be forgiven unto men.
cards.tgt_text: For it is impossible for those who were once enlightened, and have tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit),
cards.old_note: The apostolic falling-away warning.
cards.note: Hebrews 6:4 — *For it is impossible for those who were once enlightened, and have tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit),* *Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy against the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) shall not be forgiven unto men.* (Matthew 12:31) Hebrews writes of people who had tasted the heavenly gift and been *made partakers of the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit)*, and says that if they fall away there is no renewing them. *If they shall fall away, to renew them again unto repentance* (Hebrews 6:6). That is not a slip of the tongue. It is a settled turning from what the Spirit had shown them, the same weight Yahusha (Jesus) puts on this sentence.

That is not a slip of the tongue. It is a settled turning from what the Spirit had shown them, the same weight Yahusha (Jesus) puts on this sentence.
cards.member_note: Hebrews 6:4 — *have tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit).* Hebrews warns those who tasted the heavenly gift and shared in the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) and then fall away, a turning from what was plainly seen.

cards.src_text: Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy against the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) shall not be forgiven unto men.
cards.tgt_text: For if we sin wilfully after that we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remaineth no more sacrifice for sins,
cards.old_note: The apostolic *done despite unto the Spirit of grace* warning.
cards.note: Hebrews 10:26 — *For if we sin wilfully after that we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remaineth no more sacrifice for sins,* *Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy against the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) shall not be forgiven unto men.* (Matthew 12:31) What Matthew describes is a heart that has seen and turned, and Hebrews carries the same weight when it speaks of sinning *wilfully after that we have received the knowledge of the truth*. Further on it names the one who *hath done despite unto the Spirit of grace* (Hebrews 10:29), which is Matthew's blasphemy against the Spirit said another way. It describes someone who knew, not someone who stumbled.

cards.src_text: Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy against the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) shall not be forgiven unto men.
cards.tgt_text: If any man see his brother sin a sin which is not unto death, he shall ask, and he shall give him life for them that sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death: I do not say that he shall pray for it.
cards.old_note: The *sin unto death* apostolic-acknowledgment.
cards.note: 1 John 5:16 — *If any man see his brother sin a sin which is not unto death, he shall ask, and he shall give him life for them that sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death: I do not say that he shall pray for it.* *Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy against the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) shall not be forgiven unto men.* (Matthew 12:31) John knows there is such a line. A brother can be prayed for when his sin is *not unto death*, but of *a sin unto death* he says he does not tell anyone to pray. It is the same kind of line Yahusha (Jesus) draws here, between a failing that can be turned from and a refusal that has shut the door from its own side.

It is the same kind of line Yahusha (Jesus) draws here, between a failing that can be turned from and a refusal that has shut the door from its own side.
cards.member_note: 1 John 5:16 — *There is a sin unto death: I do not say that he shall pray for it.* John also recognizes a sin unto death, a different kind from the sin of a brother who can still be prayed for.

cards.src_text: Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy against the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) shall not be forgiven unto men.
cards.tgt_text: Who was before a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and injurious: but I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.
cards.old_note: Sha'ul's (Saul's) *I did it ignorantly in unbelief* — distinguishing the word-against-the-Son-of-Adam (forgivable) from the blasphemy-against-the-Ruach (the hardened-disposition).
cards.note: 1 Timothy 1:13 — *Who was before a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and injurious: but I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.* *Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy against the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) shall not be forgiven unto men.* (Matthew 12:31) Paul shows the other side of the line. He had been *a blasphemer, and a persecutor*, and yet he says he *obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief*. A word spoken against the Son of Adam in blindness is forgiven, and Paul is the proof the door stayed open for a man who had not yet seen. The ones who saw the Spirit's work and called it the devil's are the ones the saying warns.

cards.src_text: Then certain of the scribes and of the Pharisees answered, saying, Master, we would see a sign from you.
cards.tgt_text: Now Yahuah (LORD) had prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah. And Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.
cards.old_note: The Yonah-narrative the typology draws on.
cards.note: Jonah 1:17 — *Now Yahuah (LORD) had prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah. And Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.* *Then certain of the scribes and of the Pharisees answered, saying, Master, we would see a sign from you.* (Matthew 12:38) They ask for a sign, and he sends them back to a story already in their own scrolls. The fish, the belly and the *three days and three nights* are all in Jonah, and he lays the same measure beside the Son of Adam: *so shall the Son of Adam be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth* (Matthew 12:40).
cards.prose: They ask for a sign, and he sends them back to a story already in their own scrolls. The fish, the belly and the *three days and three nights* are all in Jonah, and he lays the same measure beside the Son of Adam: *so shall the Son of Adam be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth* (Matthew 12:40).
cards.member_note: Jonah 1:17 — *Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.* Jonah spent three days and three nights in the fish, the exact measure Yahusha (Jesus) names as the sign for this generation.

cards.src_text: For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale’s belly; so shall the Son of Adam be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
cards.tgt_text: Now the next day, that followed the day of the preparation, the chief priests and Pharisees came together unto Pilate,
cards.old_note: The Pharisees' own recall of the saying.
cards.note: Matthew 27:62 — *Now the next day, that followed the day of the preparation, the chief priests and Pharisees came together unto Pilate,* *For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale’s belly; so shall the Son of Adam be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.* (Matthew 12:40) The ones who asked for a sign are the ones who remember the answer. The chief priests and Pharisees come together to Pilate the next day and say, *we remember that that deceiver said, while he was yet alive, After three days I will rise again* (Matthew 27:63). They know what the sign was meant to be, and they ask that the sepulchre be made sure against it.

cards.src_text: For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale’s belly; so shall the Son of Adam be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
cards.tgt_text: In the end of the sabbath, as it began to dawn toward the first day of the week, came Mary Magdalene and the other Mary to see the sepulchre.
cards.old_note: The resurrection-narrative the sign pre-announced.
cards.note: Matthew 28:1 — *In the end of the sabbath, as it began to dawn toward the first day of the week, came Mary Magdalene and the other Mary to see the sepulchre.* *For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale’s belly; so shall the Son of Adam be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.* (Matthew 12:40) He said the Son of Adam would be *in the heart of the earth*, and this is where the saying is answered. At the end of the sabbath, with the first day just dawning, the two Marys come to the sepulchre, and the angel *rolled back the stone from the door* (Matthew 28:2).
cards.prose: He said the Son of Adam would be *in the heart of the earth*, and this is where the saying is answered. At the end of the sabbath, with the first day just dawning, the two Marys come to the sepulchre, and the angel *rolled back the stone from the door* (Matthew 28:2).
cards.member_note: Matthew 28:1 — *In the end of the sabbath, as it began to dawn toward the first day of the week.* The women come to the sepulchre at the end of the sabbath as the first day dawns, which is where the sign of the three days is answered.

cards.src_text: The men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: because they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.
cards.tgt_text: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works, which were done in you, had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.
cards.old_note: The eschatological-graduated-accountability frame restated.
cards.note: Matthew 11:21 — *Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works, which were done in you, had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.* *The men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: because they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.* (Matthew 12:41) The men of Nineveh *repented at the preaching of Jonas*, and he says they will rise against this generation. He had said it earlier of Chorazin and Bethsaida, that Tyre and Sidon would have repented in sackcloth and ashes if they had seen those works. In both places the ones who saw the most turned the least.
cards.prose: The men of Nineveh *repented at the preaching of Jonas*, and he says they will rise against this generation. He had said it earlier of Chorazin and Bethsaida, that Tyre and Sidon would have repented in sackcloth and ashes if they had seen those works. In both places the ones who saw the most turned the least.
cards.member_note: Matthew 11:21 — *if the mighty works, which were done in you, had been done in Tyre and Sidon.* Chorazin and Bethsaida saw the mighty works and did not repent, so Yahusha (Jesus) holds them to account the same way he holds this generation.

cards.src_text: For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.
cards.tgt_text: Not every one that saith unto me, Adonai (Lord), Adonai (Lord), shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven.
cards.old_note: The same *will of my Father* substance as the kingdom-entry-criterion.
cards.note: Matthew 7:21 — *Not every one that saith unto me, Adonai (Lord), Adonai (Lord), shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven.* *For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.* (Matthew 12:50) *Whosoever shall do the will of my Father* is the same test he set at the end of the Sermon, where saying *Adonai (Lord), Adonai (Lord)* gets no one in and *he that doeth the will of my Father* does. His brother, sister and mother are known by what is done with the Father's will, and not by what a man calls him.
cards.prose: *Whosoever shall do the will of my Father* is the same test he set at the end of the Sermon, where saying *Adonai (Lord), Adonai (Lord)* gets no one in and *he that doeth the will of my Father* does. His brother, sister and mother are known by what is done with the Father's will, and not by what a man calls him.
cards.member_note: Matthew 7:21 — *but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven.* At the end of the Sermon the one who does the will of his Father is the one who enters, the same test that names his family here.

cards.src_text: For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.
cards.tgt_text: When the Son of Adam shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory:
cards.old_note: The sheep-and-goats judgment with the deeds-as-evidence pattern.
cards.note: Matthew 25:31 — *When the Son of Adam shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory:* *For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.* (Matthew 12:50) The one who names his family by doing the Father's will is the same one who will *sit upon the throne of his glory*. And when the King speaks from there he says *Come, ye blessed of my Father* (Matthew 25:34), so the family is named now and the judgment will call it by the same name.
cards.prose: The one who names his family by doing the Father's will is the same one who will *sit upon the throne of his glory*. And when the King speaks from there he says *Come, ye blessed of my Father* (Matthew 25:34), so the family is named now and the judgment will call it by the same name.
cards.member_note: Matthew 25:31 — *then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory.* The Son of Adam comes on the throne of his glory and calls those on his right hand blessed of his Father.

cards.src_text: For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.
cards.tgt_text: Ye are my friends, if ye do whatsoever I command you.
cards.old_note: *Ye are my friends, if ye do whatsoever I command you.*
cards.note: John 15:14 — *Ye are my friends, if ye do whatsoever I command you.* *For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.* (Matthew 12:50) The family he points to in the field gets the same shape in John. A brother, sister or mother is the one who does the Father's will, and a friend is the one who does *whatsoever I command you*. Closeness to him is measured by doing what he says, not by standing outside and calling for him.
cards.prose: The family he points to in the field gets the same shape in John. A brother, sister or mother is the one who does the Father's will, and a friend is the one who does *whatsoever I command you*. Closeness to him is measured by doing what he says, not by standing outside and calling for him.
cards.member_note: John 15:14 — *Ye are my friends, if ye do whatsoever I command you.* Yahusha (Jesus) calls those his friends who do whatsoever he commands, the same doing that makes a brother, sister and mother.

cards.src_text: For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.
cards.tgt_text: And hereby we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.
cards.old_note: The contrary-to-Torah test master-filter.
cards.note: 1 John 2:3 — *And hereby we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.* *For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.* (Matthew 12:50) How is it known who belongs to him? John says *we know him, if we keep his commandments*, and the next verse calls the man who says he knows him and does not keep them a liar. That is the measure Yahusha (Jesus) sets here: not who stands outside calling for him, but who does the will of his Father.
cards.prose: How is it known who belongs to him? John says *we know him, if we keep his commandments*, and the next verse calls the man who says he knows him and does not keep them a liar. That is the measure Yahusha (Jesus) sets here: not who stands outside calling for him, but who does the will of his Father.
cards.member_note: 1 John 2:3 — *And hereby we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.* John says we know that we know him if we keep his commandments, the same measure of belonging Yahusha (Jesus) uses for his family.

cards.src_text: While he yet talked to the people, behold, his mother and his brethren stood without, desiring to speak with him.
cards.tgt_text: When Yahusha (Jesus) therefore saw his mother, and the disciple standing by, whom he loved, he saith unto his mother, Woman, behold thy son!
cards.old_note: Yahusha (Jesus) honoring his mother at the cross — the Torah's-family-substance preserved.
cards.note: John 19:26 — *When Yahusha (Jesus) therefore saw his mother, and the disciple standing by, whom he loved, he saith unto his mother, Woman, behold thy son!* *While he yet talked to the people, behold, his mother and his brethren stood without, desiring to speak with him.* (Matthew 12:46) When his mother and his brethren *stood without* he did not turn from her. At the cross he sees his mother and puts her in the care of the disciple, and *from that hour that disciple took her unto his own home* (John 19:27). The man who names the Father's family keeps the commandment to honour his mother to his last hour.
cards.prose: When his mother and his brethren *stood without* he did not turn from her. At the cross he sees his mother and puts her in the care of the disciple, and *from that hour that disciple took her unto his own home* (John 19:27). The man who names the Father's family keeps the commandment to honour his mother to his last hour.
cards.member_note: John 19:26 — *When Yahusha (Jesus) therefore saw his mother, and the disciple standing by, whom he loved, he saith unto his mother, Woman, behold thy son!* At the cross he sees his mother and gives her a home with the disciple, so the family he names by the Father's will never sets honour aside.

cards.src_text: While he yet talked to the people, behold, his mother and his brethren stood without, desiring to speak with him.
cards.tgt_text: And he said unto them, Full well ye reject the commandment of Elohim (God), that ye may keep your own tradition.
cards.old_note: The *Corban* indictment defending the fifth-commandment — the framework rules out the anti-family reading of Matt 12.
cards.note: Mark 7:9 — *And he said unto them, Full well ye reject the commandment of Elohim (God), that ye may keep your own tradition.* *While he yet talked to the people, behold, his mother and his brethren stood without, desiring to speak with him.* (Matthew 12:46) Nothing here is Yahusha (Jesus) setting his family aside, and Mark shows why. There he rebukes men who *reject the commandment of Elohim (God)* to hold their own tradition, and the example is Corban, a gift declared so a son need do nothing more for his father or mother. A man who holds the honouring of parents that high is not turning his own mother away.
cards.prose: Nothing here is Yahusha (Jesus) setting his family aside, and Mark shows why. There he rebukes men who *reject the commandment of Elohim (God)* to hold their own tradition, and the example is Corban, a gift declared so a son need do nothing more for his father or mother. A man who holds the honouring of parents that high is not turning his own mother away.
cards.member_note: Mark 7:9 — *And he said unto them, Full well ye reject the commandment of Elohim (God), that ye may keep your own tradition.* Mark records him rebuking men who reject the commandment of Elohim (God) for their own tradition, using the example of leaving father and mother without help.

cards.src_text: For the Son of Adam is the Lord even of the sabbath day.
cards.tgt_text: Thus saith Yahuah (LORD), Keep ye judgment, and do justice: for my salvation is near to come, and my righteousness to be revealed.
cards.old_note: The Tanakh-stream of Shabbat-as-eschatological-substance.
cards.note: Isaiah 56:1 — *Thus saith Yahuah (LORD), Keep ye judgment, and do justice: for my salvation is near to come, and my righteousness to be revealed.* *For the Son of Adam is the Lord even of the sabbath day.* (Matthew 12:8) He is *Adonai (Lord) even of the sabbath day*, and Isaiah shows what kind of day that is. Yahuah (the LORD) begins with *Keep ye judgment, and do justice*, and in the next breath blesses the man that *keepeth the sabbath from polluting it* (Isaiah 56:2). Justice and the sabbath are held together there, and the men who condemned the guiltless over a few ears of corn had pulled them apart.
cards.prose: He is *Adonai (Lord) even of the sabbath day*, and Isaiah shows what kind of day that is. Yahuah (the LORD) begins with *Keep ye judgment, and do justice*, and in the next breath blesses the man that *keepeth the sabbath from polluting it* (Isaiah 56:2). Justice and the sabbath are held together there, and the men who condemned the guiltless over a few ears of corn had pulled them apart.
cards.member_note: Isaiah 56:1 — *Thus saith Yahuah (LORD), Keep ye judgment, and do justice: for my salvation is near to come, and my righteousness to be revealed.* Isaiah joins keeping judgment and doing justice with keeping the sabbath from polluting it, so mercy and the sabbath are held in one breath.

cards.src_text: Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the Gentiles.
cards.tgt_text: And the spirit of Yahuah (LORD) shall rest upon him, the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of Yahuah (LORD);
cards.old_note: The Spirit-anointing parallel.
cards.note: Isaiah 11:2 — *And the spirit of Yahuah (LORD) shall rest upon him, the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of Yahuah (LORD);* *Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the Gentiles.* (Matthew 12:18) *I will put my spirit upon him*, the passage says, and Isaiah had already seen that Spirit resting on the Branch that grows out of Jesse's stem. It comes with wisdom and understanding, counsel and might, so the servant who heals quietly and does not strive carries the whole anointing the prophets looked for.
cards.prose: *I will put my spirit upon him*, the passage says, and Isaiah had already seen that Spirit resting on the Branch that grows out of Jesse's stem. It comes with wisdom and understanding, counsel and might, so the servant who heals quietly and does not strive carries the whole anointing the prophets looked for.
cards.member_note: Isaiah 11:2 — *the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might.* Isaiah sees the Spirit of Yahuah (the LORD) resting on the Branch from Jesse with wisdom, understanding, counsel and might, the anointing the servant carries.

cards.src_text: Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the Gentiles.
cards.tgt_text: The Spirit of Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) is upon me; because Yahuah (LORD) hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound;
cards.old_note: The Spirit-anointing-to-preach Tanakh-anchor.
cards.note: Isaiah 61:1 — *The Spirit of Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) is upon me; because Yahuah (LORD) hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound;* *Behold my servant, whom I have chosen; my beloved, in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my spirit upon him, and he shall shew judgment to the Gentiles.* (Matthew 12:18) Matthew has the Spirit put upon the servant, and Isaiah gives that Spirit its errand. He is anointed to preach good tidings to the meek, to bind up the brokenhearted and to open the prison to them that are bound, which is the work the servant is doing in this chapter when he heals them all and breaks no bruised reed.
cards.prose: Matthew has the Spirit put upon the servant, and Isaiah gives that Spirit its errand. He is anointed to preach good tidings to the meek, to bind up the brokenhearted and to open the prison to them that are bound, which is the work the servant is doing in this chapter when he heals them all and breaks no bruised reed.
cards.member_note: Isaiah 61:1 — *hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek.* Isaiah has the one anointed by the Spirit sent to the meek, the brokenhearted and the bound, which is the work the servant is doing.

cards.src_text: But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of Elohim (God), then the kingdom of Elohim (God) is come unto you.
cards.tgt_text: From that time Yahusha (Jesus) began to preach, and to say, Repent: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
cards.old_note: The kingdom-at-hand proclamation.
cards.note: Matthew 4:17 — *From that time Yahusha (Jesus) began to preach, and to say, Repent: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.* *But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of Elohim (God), then the kingdom of Elohim (God) is come unto you.* (Matthew 12:28) At the start of his preaching he said *the kingdom of heaven is at hand*, and here, with the devil cast out of the blind and dumb man, he says that it has come: *the kingdom of Elohim (God) is come unto you*. What was near is now standing in front of them, and what it looks like is a man set free.
cards.prose: At the start of his preaching he said *the kingdom of heaven is at hand*, and here, with the devil cast out of the blind and dumb man, he says that it has come: *the kingdom of Elohim (God) is come unto you*. What was near is now standing in front of them, and what it looks like is a man set free.
cards.member_note: Matthew 4:17 — *From that time Yahusha (Jesus) began to preach, and to say, Repent: for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.* At the start he preached that the kingdom of heaven was at hand, and casting out the devil is the sign that it has arrived.

cards.src_text: But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of Elohim (God), then the kingdom of Elohim (God) is come unto you.
cards.tgt_text: But if I with the finger of Elohim (God) cast out devils, no doubt the kingdom of Elohim (God) is come upon you.
cards.old_note: The Lukan parallel with *finger of Elohim (God)* instead of *Spirit.*
cards.note: Luke 11:20 — *But if I with the finger of Elohim (God) cast out devils, no doubt the kingdom of Elohim (God) is come upon you.* *But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of Elohim (God), then the kingdom of Elohim (God) is come unto you.* (Matthew 12:28) Luke has the same sentence with a different word in it. Where Matthew says *the Spirit of Elohim (God)*, Luke says *finger of Elohim (God)*, and both are the one power of Elohim (God) at work. Either way the Pharisees are left in the same spot, since the power they put down to Beelzebub is Elohim's (God's) own.
cards.prose: Luke has the same sentence with a different word in it. Where Matthew says *the Spirit of Elohim (God)*, Luke says *finger of Elohim (God)*, and both are the one power of Elohim (God) at work. Either way the Pharisees are left in the same spot, since the power they put down to Beelzebub is Elohim's (God's) own.
cards.member_note: Luke 11:20 — *But if I with the finger of Elohim (God) cast out devils, no doubt the kingdom of Elohim (God) is come upon you.* Luke says the finger of Elohim (God) where Matthew says the Spirit, the same power at work, and the kingdom has come upon them.

cards.src_text: But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of Elohim (God), then the kingdom of Elohim (God) is come unto you.
cards.tgt_text: And in the days of these kings shall the Elohim (God) of heaven set up a kingdom, which shall never be destroyed: and the kingdom shall not be left to other people, but it shall break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms, and it shall stand for ever.
cards.old_note: The Tanakh-anchor of the kingdom-of-Elohim's-arrival.
cards.note: Daniel 2:44 — *And in the days of these kings shall the Elohim (God) of heaven set up a kingdom, which shall never be destroyed: and the kingdom shall not be left to other people, but it shall break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms, and it shall stand for ever.* *But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of Elohim (God), then the kingdom of Elohim (God) is come unto you.* (Matthew 12:28) Daniel saw a kingdom raised up by heaven that *shall never be destroyed*, and Yahusha (Jesus) says that kingdom has come upon them while he casts out the spirit that held a man bound. The kingdoms that crumble are the ones he is overcoming, and the one he brings is the one Daniel was told would stand.
cards.prose: Daniel saw a kingdom raised up by heaven that *shall never be destroyed*, and Yahusha (Jesus) says that kingdom has come upon them while he casts out the spirit that held a man bound. The kingdoms that crumble are the ones he is overcoming, and the one he brings is the one Daniel was told would stand.
cards.member_note: Daniel 2:44 — *shall the Elohim (God) of heaven set up a kingdom, which shall never be destroyed.* Daniel saw a kingdom raised up by heaven that would never be destroyed, the kingdom that has come upon them as the devil is cast out.

cards.src_text: He that is not with me is against me; and he that gathers not with me scatters abroad.
cards.tgt_text: And not for that nation only, but that also he should gather together in one the children of Elohim (God) that were scattered abroad.
cards.old_note: *Should gather together in one the children of Elohim (God) that were scattered abroad* — the gathering-of-the-scattered Tanakh-and-NT substance.
cards.note: John 11:52 — *And not for that nation only, but that also he should gather together in one the children of Elohim (God) that were scattered abroad.* *He that is not with me is against me; and he that gathers not with me scatters abroad.* (Matthew 12:30) He says whoever *gathereth not with me scattereth abroad*, and John tells us what the gathering is. Yahusha (Jesus) was to die *not for that nation only*, but to gather into one the *children of Elohim (God) that were scattered abroad*. So the question he puts to the Pharisees is whose side of that work they are standing on.
cards.prose: He says whoever *gathereth not with me scattereth abroad*, and John tells us what the gathering is. Yahusha (Jesus) was to die *not for that nation only*, but to gather into one the *children of Elohim (God) that were scattered abroad*. So the question he puts to the Pharisees is whose side of that work they are standing on.
cards.member_note: John 11:52 — *And not for that nation only, but that also he should gather together in one the children of Elohim (God) that were scattered abroad.* John says Yahusha (Jesus) came to gather into one the children of Elohim (God) who were scattered abroad, the gathering he says some refuse to join.

cards.src_text: He that is not with me is against me; and he that gathers not with me scatters abroad.
cards.tgt_text: For thus saith Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I, even I, will both search my sheep, and seek them out.
cards.old_note: The shepherd's-gathering-of-the-lost-sheep Tanakh-anchor.
cards.note: Ezekiel 34:11 — *For thus saith Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I, even I, will both search my sheep, and seek them out.* *He that is not with me is against me; and he that gathers not with me scatters abroad.* (Matthew 12:30) Whoever does not gather with him scatters, he says, and Ezekiel shows whose flock this is. Yahuah (the LORD) himself says he will *search my sheep, and seek them out*, and a few verses on, *I will bring them out from the people, and gather them from the countries* (Ezekiel 34:13). So when Yahusha (Jesus) names the gathering as the test, he is naming the Shepherd's own work.
cards.prose: Whoever does not gather with him scatters, he says, and Ezekiel shows whose flock this is. Yahuah (the LORD) himself says he will *search my sheep, and seek them out*, and a few verses on, *I will bring them out from the people, and gather them from the countries* (Ezekiel 34:13). So when Yahusha (Jesus) names the gathering as the test, he is naming the Shepherd's own work.
cards.member_note: Ezekiel 34:11 — *For thus saith Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I, even I, will both search my sheep, and seek them out.* Yahuah (the LORD) promises to search out his scattered sheep and bring them home, so the gathering Yahusha (Jesus) speaks of is the Shepherd's own work.

cards.src_text: The men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: because they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.
cards.tgt_text: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the name of Yahuah (LORD), she came to prove him with hard questions.
cards.old_note: The queen-of-Sheva's coming-to-Shelomoh (Solomon) referenced.
cards.note: 1 Kings 10:1 — *And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the name of Yahuah (LORD), she came to prove him with hard questions.* *The men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: because they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.* (Matthew 12:41) Yahusha (Jesus) sets the queen of the south beside the men of Nineveh as a witness against this generation. She heard of Solomon's fame, came to Jerusalem with a great train and put her hard questions to him, and he says *a greater than Solomon is here* (Matthew 12:42) while they ask him only for a sign.
cards.prose: Yahusha (Jesus) sets the queen of the south beside the men of Nineveh as a witness against this generation. She heard of Solomon's fame, came to Jerusalem with a great train and put her hard questions to him, and he says *a greater than Solomon is here* (Matthew 12:42) while they ask him only for a sign.
cards.member_note: 1 Kings 10:1 — *she came to prove him with hard questions.* The queen of Sheba heard of Solomon's fame and came with hard questions, the witness Yahusha (Jesus) sets against a generation with a greater than Solomon before it.

cards.src_text: The men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: because they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.
cards.tgt_text: Yahuah Elohayka (The LORD thy God) will raise up unto thee a Prophet from the midst of thee, of thy brethren, like unto me; unto him ye shall hearken;
cards.old_note: The prophet-like-unto-Mosheh (Moses) the King fulfills as greater than even Yonah's-stature.
cards.note: Deuteronomy 18:15 — *Yahuah Elohayka (The LORD thy God) will raise up unto thee a Prophet from the midst of thee, of thy brethren, like unto me; unto him ye shall hearken;* *The men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: because they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here.* (Matthew 12:41) The Ninevites and the queen of the south stand up against this generation, and Moses had already told Yashar'el (Israel) whom they were to listen to. *Unto him ye shall hearken*, he said of a Prophet raised up from among their brethren. When Yahusha (Jesus) says a greater than Jonas is here, the greater one is the Prophet Moses pointed to, and a generation asking for a sign is being asked to do what Moses said.
cards.prose: The Ninevites and the queen of the south stand up against this generation, and Moses had already told Yashar'el (Israel) whom they were to listen to. *Unto him ye shall hearken*, he said of a Prophet raised up from among their brethren. When Yahusha (Jesus) says a greater than Jonas is here, the greater one is the Prophet Moses pointed to, and a generation asking for a sign is being asked to do what Moses said.
cards.member_note: Deuteronomy 18:15 — *will raise up unto thee a Prophet from the midst of thee, of thy brethren, like unto me.* Moses told Yashar'el (Israel) that Yahuah (the LORD) would raise up a Prophet from among their brethren, and to him they were to hearken.

cards.src_text: But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way.
cards.tgt_text: And it came to pass, when men began to multiply on the face of the earth, and daughters were born unto them,
cards.old_note: The fallen-angels' incursion bringing the giants — the first tares-sown-in-by-the-enemy.
cards.note: Genesis 6:1 — *And it came to pass, when men began to multiply on the face of the earth, and daughters were born unto them,* *But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way.* (Matthew 13:25) The householder sowed good seed, and *while men slept* his enemy came and sowed the tares. Genesis shows the hour. Men began to multiply and daughters were born, and the verse after it says *the sons of Elohim (God) saw the daughters of men that they were fair* (Genesis 6:2). Nobody in the field was watching when the other seed went in.
cards.prose: The householder sowed good seed, and *while men slept* his enemy came and sowed the tares. Genesis shows the hour. Men began to multiply and daughters were born, and the verse after it says *the sons of Elohim (God) saw the daughters of men that they were fair* (Genesis 6:2). Nobody in the field was watching when the other seed went in.
cards.member_note: Genesis 6:1 — *And it came to pass, when men began to multiply on the face of the earth, and daughters were born unto them,* Men multiply on the earth and daughters are born, the opening of the hour when the enemy's seed was sown among them.

cards.src_text: But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way.
cards.tgt_text: Now the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field which Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) had made. And he said unto the woman, Yea, hath Elohim (God) said, Ye shall not eat of every tree of the garden?
cards.old_note: The serpent in the garden — the dragon's corruption of the line; Genesis 3:15's seed-war foretold.
cards.note: Genesis 3:1 — *Now the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field which Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) had made. And he said unto the woman, Yea, hath Elohim (God) said, Ye shall not eat of every tree of the garden?* *But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way.* (Matthew 13:25) The tares were sown by an enemy who *went his way* once the work was done. In the garden his work is a question put to the woman, *hath Elohim (God) said*, and from that first tree the enemy's seed runs on in the line of Adam. What the householder finds in the field was begun there.
cards.prose: The tares were sown by an enemy who *went his way* once the work was done. In the garden his work is a question put to the woman, *hath Elohim (God) said*, and from that first tree the enemy's seed runs on in the line of Adam. What the householder finds in the field was begun there.
cards.member_note: Genesis 3:1 — *And he said unto the woman, Yea, hath Elohim (God) said, Ye shall not eat of every tree of the garden?* The serpent's first words to the woman put what Elohim (God) had said in doubt, the enemy sowing his seed in the garden.

cards.src_text: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;
cards.tgt_text: Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.
cards.old_note: *Ye are of your father the devil* — direct identification of the children-of-the-wicked-one substance.
cards.note: John 8:44 — *Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.* *The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;* (Matthew 13:38) The King says the tares are *the children of the wicked one*, and here he tells particular men standing in front of him whose father they are, a murderer from the beginning and the father of lies. He says it to those who would not hear his word, not to the whole people. A tare is known by its father.
cards.prose: The King says the tares are *the children of the wicked one*, and here he tells particular men standing in front of him whose father they are, a murderer from the beginning and the father of lies. He says it to those who would not hear his word, not to the whole people. A tare is known by its father.
cards.member_note: John 8:44 — *Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do.* Yahusha (Jesus) names the father of men who would not hear him, the plain statement that some in the crowd are children of the wicked one.

cards.src_text: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;
cards.tgt_text: Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.
cards.old_note: *In this the children of Elohim (God) are manifest, and the children of the devil* — the apostolic restatement.
cards.note: 1 John 3:8 — *Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.* *The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;* (Matthew 13:38) John writes from the other side of the same field. The devil has been at his work from the beginning, and the Son of Elohim (God) appeared to put an end to what he built. The tares in the parable are his children, which is why the Son of Adam clears them out at the harvest.
cards.prose: John writes from the other side of the same field. The devil has been at his work from the beginning, and the Son of Elohim (God) appeared to put an end to what he built. The tares in the parable are his children, which is why the Son of Adam clears them out at the harvest.
cards.member_note: 1 John 3:8 — *Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.* John says the devil has worked from the beginning and the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed to undo his works.

cards.src_text: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;
cards.tgt_text: Now the sons of Eli were sons of Belial; they knew not Yahuah (LORD).
cards.old_note: The sons of Belial within the covenant community (Eli's sons Hophni and Phinehas) — the within-the-line operation.
cards.note: 1 Samuel 2:12 — *Now the sons of Eli were sons of Belial; they knew not Yahuah (LORD).* *The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;* (Matthew 13:38) Here a tare stands inside the field wearing the field's own colors. These are a priest's sons, born in the chosen line, and they are *sons of Belial*, men who did not know Yahuah (the LORD). The *children of the wicked one* are not only out among the nations. Some were sown into the house itself.
cards.prose: Here a tare stands inside the field wearing the field's own colors. These are a priest's sons, born in the chosen line, and they are *sons of Belial*, men who did not know Yahuah (the LORD). The *children of the wicked one* are not only out among the nations. Some were sown into the house itself.
cards.member_note: 1 Samuel 2:12 — *Now the sons of Eli were sons of Belial; they knew not Yahuah (LORD).* Priest's sons born in the chosen line are called sons of Belial who knew not Yahuah (the LORD), a tare sown inside the house.

cards.src_text: Let both grow together until the harvest: and in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers, Gather you together first the tares, and bind them in bundles to burn them: but gather the wheat into my barn.
cards.tgt_text: As I live, saith Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), surely with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out, will I rule over you:
cards.old_note: The post-harvest sifting under the rod in the wilderness of the people — the framework's eschatological architecture.
cards.note: Ezekiel 20:33 — *As I live, saith Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), surely with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out, will I rule over you:* *Let both grow together until the harvest: and in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers, Gather you together first the tares, and bind them in bundles to burn them: but gather the wheat into my barn.* (Matthew 13:30) The wheat is gathered into the barn, but gathered wheat does not go straight home. Yahuah (the LORD) says here that he will *rule over you* with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm, and the verses that follow bring the house out of the countries to the wilderness. *And I will bring you into the wilderness of the people, and there will I plead with you face to face.* (Ezekiel 20:35)
cards.prose: The wheat is gathered into the barn, but gathered wheat does not go straight home. Yahuah (the LORD) says here that he will *rule over you* with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm, and the verses that follow bring the house out of the countries to the wilderness. *And I will bring you into the wilderness of the people, and there will I plead with you face to face.* (Ezekiel 20:35)
cards.member_note: Ezekiel 20:33 — *surely with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out, will I rule over you.* Yahuah (the LORD) will rule over the scattered house with a mighty hand and bring it into the wilderness to be tried face to face.

cards.src_text: The Son of Adam shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity;
cards.tgt_text: As I live, saith Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), surely with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out, will I rule over you:
cards.old_note: The post-harvest sifting under the rod in the wilderness of the people — the framework's eschatological architecture.
cards.note: Ezekiel 20:33 — *As I live, saith Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), surely with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out, will I rule over you:* *The Son of Adam shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity;* (Matthew 13:41) The Son of Adam sends his angels to gather out of *his kingdom* all that offends and does iniquity. Ezekiel shows what the clearing is for. Yahuah (the LORD) will rule over the house he scattered, and he says he will gather it: *I will bring you out from the people, and will gather you out of the countries wherein ye are scattered* (Ezekiel 20:34). Clearing and gathering are one work.
cards.prose: The Son of Adam sends his angels to gather out of *his kingdom* all that offends and does iniquity. Ezekiel shows what the clearing is for. Yahuah (the LORD) will rule over the house he scattered, and he says he will gather it: *I will bring you out from the people, and will gather you out of the countries wherein ye are scattered* (Ezekiel 20:34). Clearing and gathering are one work.
cards.member_note: Ezekiel 20:33 — *surely with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out, will I rule over you.* Yahuah (the LORD) declares he will rule over the house he scattered, the rule that clears the kingdom and gathers his people home.

cards.src_text: The Son of Adam shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity;
cards.tgt_text: Not every one that saith unto me, Adonai (Lord), Adonai (Lord), shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven.
cards.old_note: The *anomia* (lawlessness) diagnostic — the same substance the post-harvest-sifting tests.
cards.note: Matthew 7:21 — *Not every one that saith unto me, Adonai (Lord), Adonai (Lord), shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven.* *The Son of Adam shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity;* (Matthew 13:41) The angels gather out *them which do iniquity*, and the Sermon holds the same measure over everyone who calls him *Adonai (Lord), Adonai (Lord)*. The one who enters is *he that doeth the will of my Father*. Naming him is not the standard. Doing what the Father said is.
cards.prose: The angels gather out *them which do iniquity*, and the Sermon holds the same measure over everyone who calls him *Adonai (Lord), Adonai (Lord)*. The one who enters is *he that doeth the will of my Father*. Naming him is not the standard. Doing what the Father said is.
cards.member_note: Matthew 7:21 — *but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven.* Lawlessness is the measure: only the one who does the will of the Father enters, whatever he calls the King.

cards.src_text: The Son of Adam shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity;
cards.tgt_text: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and will gather the wheat into his garner; but the chaff he will burn with fire unquenchable.
cards.old_note: *Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and gather the wheat into his garner* — Yochanan's (John's) anticipation of the post-harvest sifting.
cards.note: Luke 3:17 — *Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and will gather the wheat into his garner; but the chaff he will burn with fire unquenchable.* *The Son of Adam shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity;* (Matthew 13:41) In the parable the tares are taken out first and burned. John sets the second step beside it. Once the wheat is in, the fan goes through the floor and the chaff is burned with fire that cannot be put out. Those are two clearings, one after the other, and the wheat comes through both.
cards.prose: In the parable the tares are taken out first and burned. John sets the second step beside it. Once the wheat is in, the fan goes through the floor and the chaff is burned with fire that cannot be put out. Those are two clearings, one after the other, and the wheat comes through both.
cards.member_note: Luke 3:17 — *Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and will gather the wheat into his garner; but the chaff he will burn with fire unquenchable.* John says the coming one clears his floor, keeps the wheat in his garner, and burns the chaff with unquenchable fire.

cards.src_text: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who has ears to hear, let him hear.
cards.tgt_text: Then shall the King say unto them on his right hand, Come, ye blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world:
cards.old_note: *Inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world* — the kingdom-of-the-Father preparation substance.
cards.note: Matthew 25:34 — *Then shall the King say unto them on his right hand, Come, ye blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world:* *Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who has ears to hear, let him hear.* (Matthew 13:43) The righteous shine in the kingdom of *their Father*, and here the King calls them *blessed of my Father* and says the kingdom was made ready for them from the foundation of the world. The shining at the end of the field is the inheritance of people whose place was prepared before anything was sown.
cards.prose: The righteous shine in the kingdom of *their Father*, and here the King calls them *blessed of my Father* and says the kingdom was made ready for them from the foundation of the world. The shining at the end of the field is the inheritance of people whose place was prepared before anything was sown.
cards.member_note: Matthew 25:34 — *Then shall the King say unto them on his right hand, Come, ye blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world:* The King welcomes the blessed to a kingdom prepared for them from the foundation of the world.

cards.src_text: Let both grow together until the harvest: and in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers, Gather you together first the tares, and bind them in bundles to burn them: but gather the wheat into my barn.
cards.tgt_text: And it shall come to pass, that in all the land, saith Yahuah (LORD), two parts therein shall be cut off and die; but the third shall be left therein.
cards.old_note: The two-thirds-cut-off / one-third-through-the-fire — the prophetic-disqualifier of lineage-claim-alone per `_COMMENTARY_SUMMATION.md` §V.
cards.note: Zechariah 13:8 — *And it shall come to pass, that in all the land, saith Yahuah (LORD), two parts therein shall be cut off and die; but the third shall be left therein.* *Let both grow together until the harvest: and in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers, Gather you together first the tares, and bind them in bundles to burn them: but gather the wheat into my barn.* (Matthew 13:30) Both grow together until the harvest, and Zechariah shows what the harvest does to the land: *two parts therein shall be cut off and die*, and the third is left. Standing in the field was never the same as being wheat, and the fire the third part passes through is what shows the difference.
cards.prose: Both grow together until the harvest, and Zechariah shows what the harvest does to the land: *two parts therein shall be cut off and die*, and the third is left. Standing in the field was never the same as being wheat, and the fire the third part passes through is what shows the difference.
cards.member_note: Zechariah 13:8 — *two parts therein shall be cut off and die; but the third shall be left therein.* In all the land two parts are cut off and die and a third is left, so being born in the field is not enough.

cards.src_text: The enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.
cards.tgt_text: And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.
cards.old_note: The angels-with-the-trumpet gathering the elect from the four-winds — the reapers' work.
cards.note: Matthew 24:31 — *And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.* *The enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.* (Matthew 13:39) In the parable the reapers are the angels, and they take up the tares first. Here the Son of Adam sends the same angels out with a great trumpet, and what they gather is *his elect from the four winds*. The harvest clears the field and it also brings the chosen in from every direction.
cards.prose: In the parable the reapers are the angels, and they take up the tares first. Here the Son of Adam sends the same angels out with a great trumpet, and what they gather is *his elect from the four winds*. The harvest clears the field and it also brings the chosen in from every direction.
cards.member_note: Matthew 24:31 — *they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.* The Son of Adam sends his angels with a trumpet to gather his elect from the four winds.

cards.src_text: Then Yahusha (Jesus) sent the multitude away, and went into the house: and his disciples came unto him, saying, Declare unto us the parable of the tares of the field.
cards.tgt_text: And I looked, and behold a white cloud, and upon the cloud one sat like unto the Son of Adam, having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.
cards.old_note: The harvest of the earth and the winepress of the wrath — the framework's Revelation-reading carries the harvest-architecture.
cards.note: Revelation 14:14 — *And I looked, and behold a white cloud, and upon the cloud one sat like unto the Son of Adam, having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.* *Then Yahusha (Jesus) sent the multitude away, and went into the house: and his disciples came unto him, saying, Declare unto us the parable of the tares of the field.* (Matthew 13:36) The disciples ask for the parable of the tares to be declared, and he tells them the harvest is the end and the reapers are angels. John sees it. On a white cloud sits one *like unto the Son of Adam*, a golden crown on his head and a sharp sickle in his hand, and the time to reap has come.
cards.prose: The disciples ask for the parable of the tares to be declared, and he tells them the harvest is the end and the reapers are angels. John sees it. On a white cloud sits one *like unto the Son of Adam*, a golden crown on his head and a sharp sickle in his hand, and the time to reap has come.
cards.member_note: Revelation 14:14 — *upon the cloud one sat like unto the Son of Adam, having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.* John sees the harvest of the earth: one like the Son of Adam on a white cloud with a crown and a sharp sickle.

cards.src_text: Therefore speak I to them in parables: because they seeing see not; and hearing they hear not, neither do they understand.
cards.tgt_text: And he said, Go, and tell this people, Hear ye indeed, but understand not; and see ye indeed, but perceive not.
cards.old_note: Direct Tanakh-source.
cards.note: Isaiah 6:9 — *And he said, Go, and tell this people, Hear ye indeed, but understand not; and see ye indeed, but perceive not.* *Therefore speak I to them in parables: because they seeing see not; and hearing they hear not, neither do they understand.* (Matthew 13:13) Yahusha (Jesus) says he speaks in parables *because they seeing see not*, and the words behind that are Isaiah's. The prophet is sent to *this people* with a word to hear indeed and not understand. The parables are given the way that word was given, so that this people hear and do not understand.
cards.prose: Yahusha (Jesus) says he speaks in parables *because they seeing see not*, and the words behind that are Isaiah's. The prophet is sent to *this people* with a word to hear indeed and not understand. The parables are given the way that word was given, so that this people hear and do not understand.
cards.member_note: Isaiah 6:9 — *And he said, Go, and tell this people, Hear ye indeed, but understand not; and see ye indeed, but perceive not.* Isaiah is sent to this people with the word to hear indeed and not understand, the commission Matthew says the parables fulfil.

cards.src_text: He answered and said unto them, Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.
cards.tgt_text: But ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep, as I said unto you.
cards.old_note: *Ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep ... my sheep hear my voice* — the same cause-and-effect-of-hearing diagnostic.
cards.note: John 10:26 — *But ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep, as I said unto you.* *He answered and said unto them, Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.* (Matthew 13:11) The mysteries are given to some, and to others it is *not given*. The Shepherd says the reason in his own words: *ye are not of my sheep*. Then he adds, *My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me* (John 10:27). The giving comes before the hearing, and the hearing shows whose they were.
cards.prose: The mysteries are given to some, and to others it is *not given*. The Shepherd says the reason in his own words: *ye are not of my sheep*. Then he adds, *My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me* (John 10:27). The giving comes before the hearing, and the hearing shows whose they were.
cards.member_note: John 10:26 — *But ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep, as I said unto you.* Those who believe not are not of his sheep, the sheep being the ones who hear.

cards.src_text: He answered and said unto them, Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.
cards.tgt_text: But the natural man receiveth not the things of the Spirit of Elohim (God): for they are foolishness unto him: neither can he know them, because they are spiritually discerned.
cards.old_note: *The natural man receiveth not the things of the Spirit of Elohim (God): for they are foolishness unto him: neither can he know them* — the apostolic-restatement.
cards.note: 1 Corinthians 2:14 — *But the natural man receiveth not the things of the Spirit of Elohim (God): for they are foolishness unto him: neither can he know them, because they are spiritually discerned.* *He answered and said unto them, Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.* (Matthew 13:11) Paul says a man left to his own nature takes in nothing of the Spirit of Elohim (God), because *they are spiritually discerned*. It is the same line the King draws. The mysteries are given to some, and to others they sound foolish. It is not a matter of being clever enough to find them.
cards.prose: Paul says a man left to his own nature takes in nothing of the Spirit of Elohim (God), because *they are spiritually discerned*. It is the same line the King draws. The mysteries are given to some, and to others they sound foolish. It is not a matter of being clever enough to find them.
cards.member_note: 1 Corinthians 2:14 — *the natural man receiveth not the things of the Spirit of Elohim (God): for they are foolishness unto him.* The natural man cannot receive the things of the Spirit of Elohim (God); they are foolishness to him and are spiritually discerned.

cards.src_text: And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Esaias, which says, By hearing you shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing you shall see, and shall not perceive:
cards.tgt_text: But though he had done so many miracles before them, yet they believed not on him:
cards.old_note: Yochanan's (John's) gospel applies the same Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 6:9-10 citation to the broader rejection-pattern.
cards.note: John 12:37 — *But though he had done so many miracles before them, yet they believed not on him:* *And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Esaias, which says, By hearing you shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing you shall see, and shall not perceive:* (Matthew 13:14) Matthew says Isaiah's word is fulfilled in them, and John gives the same reading of the crowd. They had seen so many miracles and *they believed not on him*, and John goes straight on: *Therefore they could not believe, because that Esaias said again* (John 12:39). The unbelief was no surprise. It was what the prophet had said would be.
cards.prose: Matthew says Isaiah's word is fulfilled in them, and John gives the same reading of the crowd. They had seen so many miracles and *they believed not on him*, and John goes straight on: *Therefore they could not believe, because that Esaias said again* (John 12:39). The unbelief was no surprise. It was what the prophet had said would be.
cards.member_note: John 12:37 — *But though he had done so many miracles before them, yet they believed not on him:* Though he did so many miracles before them they believed not, and John answers it with Isaiah.

cards.src_text: And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Esaias, which says, By hearing you shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing you shall see, and shall not perceive:
cards.tgt_text: And when they agreed not among themselves, they departed, after that Paul had spoken one word, Well spake the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) by Esaias the prophet unto our fathers,
cards.old_note: Paul applies the same Yeshayahu (Isaiah) 6:9-10 citation in Rome — the same diagnostic across the apostolic-mission.
cards.note: Acts 28:25 — *And when they agreed not among themselves, they departed, after that Paul had spoken one word, Well spake the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) by Esaias the prophet unto our fathers,* *And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Esaias, which says, By hearing you shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing you shall see, and shall not perceive:* (Matthew 13:14) At Rome Paul gives the speaker of the very words Matthew quotes: the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) spoke them *by Esaias the prophet unto our fathers*. So this is an old word, not a new charge. The room divided there as the crowd by the sea did, and some went away disagreeing among themselves.
cards.prose: At Rome Paul gives the speaker of the very words Matthew quotes: the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) spoke them *by Esaias the prophet unto our fathers*. So this is an old word, not a new charge. The room divided there as the crowd by the sea did, and some went away disagreeing among themselves.
cards.member_note: Acts 28:25 — *Well spake the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) by Esaias the prophet unto our fathers.* Paul says the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) spoke the word about hearing without understanding through Isaiah to the fathers, as his hearers at Rome parted.

cards.src_text: And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Esaias, which says, By hearing you shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing you shall see, and shall not perceive:
cards.tgt_text: What then? Yashar'el (Israel) hath not obtained that which he seeketh for; but the election hath obtained it, and the rest were blinded
cards.old_note: Paul's *the election hath obtained it, and the rest were blinded* — the same architecture in different vocabulary.
cards.note: Romans 11:7 — *What then? Yashar'el (Israel) hath not obtained that which he seeketh for; but the election hath obtained it, and the rest were blinded* *And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Esaias, which says, By hearing you shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing you shall see, and shall not perceive:* (Matthew 13:14) Isaiah says they hear and do not understand. Paul says who: Yashar'el (Israel) sought and did not obtain, *but the election hath obtained it, and the rest were blinded*. The blinding falls on the rest. Those who see were the election before they looked, and the crowd by the sea shows the two sides.
cards.prose: Isaiah says they hear and do not understand. Paul says who: Yashar'el (Israel) sought and did not obtain, *but the election hath obtained it, and the rest were blinded*. The blinding falls on the rest. Those who see were the election before they looked, and the crowd by the sea shows the two sides.
cards.member_note: Romans 11:7 — *but the election hath obtained it, and the rest were blinded.* Yashar'el (Israel) did not obtain what it sought; the election obtained it and the rest were blinded.

cards.src_text: But blessed are your eyes, for they see: and your ears, for they hear.
cards.tgt_text: Of which salvation the prophets have enquired and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that should come unto you:

cards.note: 1 Peter 1:10 — *Of which salvation the prophets have enquired and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that should come unto you:* *But blessed are your eyes, for they see: and your ears, for they hear.* (Matthew 13:16) Blessed are the eyes that see, he tells the disciples, and Peter shows what that blessing cost others. The prophets *enquired and searched diligently* about this very salvation. Many of them waited and died before it came. These men are standing in the thing they longed to see.

cards.member_note: 1 Peter 1:10 — *Of which salvation the prophets have enquired and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that should come unto you:* The prophets searched diligently into the salvation the disciples are now seeing.

cards.src_text: He answered and said unto them, Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.

cards.src_text: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind:
cards.tgt_text: Then Yahusha (Jesus) sent the multitude away, and went into the house: and his disciples came unto him, saying, Declare unto us the parable of the tares of the field.
cards.old_note: The wheat-and-tares interpretation; the dragnet recapitulates the same architecture.
cards.note: Matthew 13:36 — *Then Yahusha (Jesus) sent the multitude away, and went into the house: and his disciples came unto him, saying, Declare unto us the parable of the tares of the field.* *Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind:* (Matthew 13:47) The net gathers *of every kind*, and the sorting is done at the shore. He has already shown the disciples what that sorting looks like. They asked for *the parable of the tares of the field*, and he told them the harvest is the end and the reapers are angels. The net is the same teaching in another picture.

cards.tgt_text: And he saith unto them, Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.

Casting it wide is the work he gave them. Sorting what comes up is not, because that is done at the shore by the angels.

cards.src_text: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind:
cards.tgt_text: And it shall come to pass, that every thing that liveth, which moveth, whithersoever the rivers shall come, shall live: and there shall be a very great multitude of fish, because these waters shall come thither: for they shall be healed; and every thing shall live whither the river cometh.
cards.old_note: *And it shall come to pass, that every thing that liveth, which moveth, whithersoever the rivers shall come, shall live: and there shall be a very great multitude of fish, because these waters shall come thither: for they shall be healed; and every thing shall live whither the river cometh.* (Ezekiel 47:9). The great multitude of fish in the healed waters of the reign. The net of the parable is drawn and sorted first — *so shall it be at the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just* (Matthew 13:49) — and the reign follows the severing.
cards.note: Ezekiel 47:9 — *And it shall come to pass, that every thing that liveth, which moveth, whithersoever the rivers shall come, shall live: and there shall be a very great multitude of fish, because these waters shall come thither: for they shall be healed; and every thing shall live whither the river cometh.* *Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind:* (Matthew 13:47) The net is drawn in and sorted, and the wicked are severed first. After that, Ezekiel's river brings life to everything it touches, and where the sea is healed there is *a very great multitude of fish*. The sorting at the shore comes before the healed waters of the reign.

cards.src_text: So shall it be at the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just,
cards.tgt_text: When the Son of Adam shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory:
cards.old_note: *When the Son of Adam shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory:* (Matthew 25:31). The net is drawn and *the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just* (Matthew 13:49); so the Shepherd-King divides his sheep from the goats. Both are the sorting of what has been gathered: the seed brought out of all nations and sifted before the reign, not the nations judged for entry into it.

cards.src_text: So shall it be at the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just,

cards.src_text: Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.
cards.tgt_text: Seven days shall ye eat unleavened bread; even the first day ye shall put away leaven out of your houses: for whosoever eateth leavened bread from the first day until the seventh day, that soul shall be cut off from Yashar'el (Israel).
cards.old_note: Leaven-removed-from-the-house at Pesach (Passover) — the covenant-substance of separation-from-corruption.
cards.note: Exodus 12:15 — *Seven days shall ye eat unleavened bread; even the first day ye shall put away leaven out of your houses: for whosoever eateth leavened bread from the first day until the seventh day, that soul shall be cut off from Yashar'el (Israel).* *Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.* (Matthew 13:33) A woman hides leaven in three measures of meal until the whole is leavened. The Torah says what leaven is: at the feast ye *put away leaven out of your houses*, and whoever eats it in those days is cut off from Yashar'el (Israel). So the woman's leaven is something that gets into the meal and has to be put out, not something welcomed.

cards.src_text: Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.

cards.note: Leviticus 2:11 — *No meat offering, which ye shall bring unto Yahuah (LORD), shall be made with leaven: for ye shall burn no leaven, nor any honey, in any offering of Yahuah (LORD) made by fire.* *Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.* (Matthew 13:33) Leaven is hid in the meal, and the Torah says no meal offering brought to Yahuah (the LORD) may be made with leaven. The woman does with her meal the one thing the altar does not allow. So the picture is not of something clean being added to the meal.

cards.src_text: Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.
cards.tgt_text: In the mean time, when there were gathered together an innumerable multitude of people, insomuch that they trode one upon another, he began to say unto his disciples first of all, Beware ye of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.

cards.note: Luke 12:1 — *In the mean time, when there were gathered together an innumerable multitude of people, insomuch that they trode one upon another, he began to say unto his disciples first of all, Beware ye of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.* *Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.* (Matthew 13:33) Luke has him name it in one word. cards.src_text: Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.

cards.src_text: Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.
cards.tgt_text: And Abraham hastened into the tent unto Sarah, and said, Make ready quickly three measures of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes upon the hearth.
cards.old_note: The three-measures-of-meal Sarah prepared for the covenant-meal at Yahuah's (the LORD's) visit — the framework reads the leaven-hidden-in-the-covenant-meal substance.
cards.note: Genesis 18:6 — *And Abraham hastened into the tent unto Sarah, and said, Make ready quickly three measures of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes upon the hearth.* *Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.* (Matthew 13:33) Three measures of fine meal is what Abraham told Sarah to make ready the day Yahuah (the LORD) came to his tent with two others and he hurried to feed them. The woman in the parable hides her leaven in that same quantity. It is the meal of a covenant house, the meal set before Yahuah (the LORD) himself, that the leaven is put into.

cards.src_text: Who has ears to hear, let him hear.

The hearing in the soil and the shining at the end are one road.
